policy: A command is retried once, and only when it matches command_regex and its output matches output_regex of an entry below. Every retry is reported (the retry notice on stderr, observed.json flakes[], summary.json). A second failure, or a failure outside every signature, fails. The list only shrinks: an entry whose upstream fix has landed is deleted, and an entry without an upstream reference fails the static tier (D6 §6.12).
